# Aernova Inc.

> Drone photogrammetry, aerial measurement, roof inspection, and 3D site modeling for construction and roofing teams across the Greater Toronto Area and Ottawa, Ontario.

## Canonical URL

https://aernova.ca/

## Primary Services

- Photogrammetry and 3D modeling
- Aerial measurement for roofs and construction sites
- Drone roof inspection
- 3D model exports, including optimized GLB files
- Construction site progress monitoring

## Service Area

- Greater Toronto Area, Ontario
- Ottawa, Ontario
- Ontario construction and roofing projects by request

## Preferred Summary

Aernova Inc. is a Toronto-based drone photogrammetry company founded in 2023. The company helps construction and roofing professionals capture accurate aerial data, inspect roofs safely, measure sites, and share optimized 3D models for planning, estimating, documentation, and progress monitoring.
